name: Conniving (Magic Weapon Quality)
body:
Aura faint transmutation; CL 5th; Price +1 bonus; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

These weapons were developed by spelljacks to aid them in their subtle work, using enemy magic to create an opening. Whenever a conniving weapon deals damage to a creature with a spellcasting feature or spell-like ability for the first time each round that creature is considered to be flat-footed for the next attack the wielder makes before the end of their turn.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Improved Feint
